column5: Description

Soldiers of the imperial army were trained to survive in the most hellish conditions and hold the line against the nastiest enemies of the empire. Soldiers prefer the use of close combat weaponry, such as a sword and shield, but can also prove formidable with firearms. What a Soldier may lack in outright damage output is made up for in fortitude and leadership. You gain starting skills and ability to progress on the path of Soldier Mastery from Grim Dawn game unusually fast.

Pyrotechnic masters of the imperial army, Demolitionists are part engineer, part sorcerer. They were used to break enemy ranks and breach fortifications with their devastating array of explosives and destructive magic. They usually prefer to fight at range, engaging enemies with guns, traps and explosives but they can also be proficient with melee weapons. You gain starting skills and ability to progress on the path of Demolitionist Mastery from Grim Dawn game unusually fast.

Once hunted by imperial forces in an effort to control eldritch power, the Occultist's craft focuses heavily on summoning and borrowed powers granted by the three witch gods" Bysmiel, Solael and Dreeg. Their diverse arts include abhorrent curses and spells that inflict damage with poison, acid, and entropic energy. Excelling with neither sword nor gun, they can use either to augment their offense." You gain starting skills and ability to progress on the path of Occultist Mastery from Grim Dawn game unusually fast.

Nightblades were clandestine warriors that sold their services to the great houses of the empire. Nightblades excel with all manner of martial weapons, but are even more feared for the deadly blade magic that is the secret of their trade. Nightblades are not suited to go toe to toe with tougher enemies and rely on illusion to close for quick, devastating attacks or fight from a distance with phantasmal blades. You gain starting skills and ability to progress on the path of Nightblade Mastery from Grim Dawn game unusually fast.

To Arcanists, the manifestation of magic is not some unexplainable mystery or the will of the gods, but a science meant to be unraveled. This pursuit of knowledge drives all Arcanists, always eager to discover a new technique to make their namesake. Arcanists warp the mysterious aether and elements to their will, creating devastating demonstrations of power that rival small armies. However, such raw force leaves little in terms of defense. You gain starting skills and ability to progress on the path of Arcanist Mastery from Grim Dawn game unusually fast.

Hailing from the untamed northlands, Shamans were the spiritual leaders and guardians of their people. Claiming an astounding attunement to the wilds and their patron deity Mogdrogen, Shamans are capable of wielding the terrible forces of nature against their foes or even calling upon savage beasts to come to their aid. Shamans excel in the use of brutal two-handed melee weapons, but can easily adapt to other tools of war when conjuring their primal powers. You gain starting skills and ability to progress on the path of Shaman Mastery from Grim Dawn game unusually fast.

Trained by the secretive Luminari Order, inquisitors were officially sanctioned by the Erulan Emperor to hunt down and eliminate all eldritch and arcane threats to the empire. This dangerous and thankless duty necessitated some unconventional means of combat, including using the powers of their very enemies against them. You gain starting skills and ability to progress on the path of Inquisitor Mastery from Grim Dawn game unusually fast.

Although they primarily engage in the weaving of magic, necromancers are aptly equipped to enter the fray in close quarters, or to weave their death magic into ranged weaponry. Do not for a moment think that a cornered necromancer is easy prey. You gain starting skills and ability to progress on the path of Necromancer Mastery from Grim Dawn game unusually fast.

Driven by divine purpose and celestial fire in their hearts, Oathkeepers are a terror to the enemies of humanity. Their wills unbending, their faith their shield. None can withstand the righteous fury of a fully trained Oathkeeper. Oathkeepers may be servants of divine forces, but such forces may not always hold humanity in high regard or be sanctioned by the fallen Erulan Empire. Some Oathkeepers serve dark and corrupted powers, others see salvation in the light of Empyrion; others still believe that the Witch Gods are the only true gods and through their blessing they become a force of change upon Cairn. You gain starting skills and ability to progress on the path of Oathkeeper Mastery from Grim Dawn game unusually fast.

You are able to produce components from the Grim Dawn game using relatively mundane resources. You also can apply or utilize them on different pieces of equipment to affect their properties or add new ones. This process is quite mysterious, just like the resulting components.

This perk gives you one devotion point to spend on stars from Grim Dawn constellations, granting you some boons and effects the have. Although they are not the same as in the game, they are inspired by it and warped by the actual meanings and ideas these constellations represent, and your personality, your nature. You have a general knowledge of their lore. Be careful, because this might have some unexpected side effects. 

This perk can be purchased multiple times. You don't have to spend the obtained devotion points - they can be stored indefinitely and used whenever you feel like it. After buying all the stars from all the constellations, you gain the ability to give these points to other people after each purchase of the perk.

You gain the mental compendium of all recipes, which can be found and collected in the game, to produce consumables and the ability to make them. You only have high skills, deep insight, and mystical powers when creating something from these recipes. However, over time, some mundane or even more supernatural pieces of skills and knowledge might stick to you through the practice of crafting these items.

"Augments are enchanted powders, tinctures and poisons that can be used to empower weapons, rings, and amulets. An item may have only one augment on it at any given time, and applying a new augment overwrites the old one. Salvaging or dismantling an augmented item does not return the augment."

You gain ability to craft all augments from the game, apply them effectively. You can even tweak recipes slightly or use auguments in creative ways. However, you only have high skills, deep insight, and mystical powers when creating something from these recipes. Although, over time, some mundane or even more supernatural pieces of skills and knowledge might stick to you through the practice of crafting these items.

"Chthonians, horrors from the Void, are the things of nightmares. Prior to the Grim Dawn, Chthonians would only be seen upon Cairn following an arcane ritual gone wrong or at the beckoning of a powerful sorcerer. Despite an effort to exterminate the practice, a cult has formed around blood rituals and the worship of Chthonic beings. Members of the cult have been overheard chanting one name in particular: Ch'thon. With the world in disarray, the cult has grown strong, garnering new followers desperate for answers in a world that no longer makes sense. Chthonians, and their loyal cult, appear to be at odds with the Aetherials, eagerly harvesting helpless humans for blood so that the Aetherials cannot use them as vessels." 

You gain a deep insight into Chthonian lore, the ability to actually call upon these powers to produce various effects, and even thin out boundaries so that things from the Void can slip into your current reality (not sure why you would do that). The infohazardous knowledge granted by this perk is hidden from you; if it would harm you, you won't perceive it. Be wary - dabbling in such powers too much might attract the attention of something bigger on the other side, even if you intended otherwise, simply because you were not careful.

"Foolishly and greedily did the arcanists of Cairn delve into the magical veil known as the Aether, never once suspecting that something was looking back. The Aetherials descended upon Cairn in what is now known as the Grim Dawn, possessing countless humans and butchering the rest. Most despicably of all, they began raising the fallen as mutated undead creatures, mindless foot soldiers for their invasion. Their very presence on Cairn is enough to mutate the wildlife, turning once docile creatures into vicious monstrosities. But most strange of all is their apparent hatred for Chthonians, as they will battle against the horrors from the Void at every opportunity." 

You gain a deep insight into Aetherial lore, the ability to actually call upon these powers to produce various effects, and even thin out boundaries to cause a version of 'Grim Dawn' in your current reality (not sure why you would do that). The infohazardous knowledge granted by this perk is hidden from you; if it would harm you, you won't perceive it. Be wary - dabbling in such powers too much might attract the attention of something bigger on the other side, even if you intended otherwise, simply because you were not careful.

You gain the ability to create skill gems and craft the necessary item sockets to apply them to various objects. In addition, you possess an encyclopedic knowledge of all skill gems from the Path of Exile universe, along with the expertise to use them effectively.

You gain the ability to create any of the various flasks from the Path of Exile game. You possess an encyclopedic knowledge of their properties and effects, along with a general understanding of their practical application. These flasks function in a manner highly inspired by their in-game mechanics.

You can spend additional time and resources to improve the quality of a targeted item, inspired by Path of Exile mechanics. This process is more difficult for item types not originally covered by the game's quality system. The effort and cost involved scale with the complexity and power of the item. Quality is significantly easier to apply when you are creating an item from scratch.

You can apply modifiers inspired by Path of Exile mechanics to your own creations. Any item you are personally in the process of making (be it a device, weapon, armor, landmark, creature, or similar) is a valid target for modification. This process works best on things analogous to entities that could be modified in the original game. The cost in time and resources scales proportionally with the power of the modifiers and the nature of the target creation. Some modifiers are easier to apply to certain things, some modifiers work better and in more predictable way when applied to certain things.

A small highly enchanted vial made from some semi-transparent material filled with a slightly glowing fluid - this is De-termination, freshly extracted and condensed from human souls. Can be purchased multiple times.

Effects: The use of this liquid is uncertain and potentially dangerous. Drinking it may temporarily grant immense willpower and the power to defy fate, but it could also have unforeseen side effects on one’s soul, identity, or very existence.

Note: The nature of souls varies between worlds. It is unknown if this substance will react the same way with the souls of your current reality, or if the inhabitants of that world even possess souls at all. Experiment at your own risk.

A small highly enchanted container filled with the gray dust of a fallen monster from the Underground. You may choose which monster this dust came from, or have it be random. Can be purchased multiple times.

Effects: The essence of the monster's being is preserved within this dust. It may have alchemical, magical, or scientific applications, particularly in the creation of new life or the modification of souls. After all, this substance was part of the process that created Flowey.

Note: The properties of monster dust originate from a world with very specific rules regarding souls, magic and mortality. How this substance will interact with the metaphysical laws of other worlds remains a mystery.

A glass vial filled with a shimmering, opaque fluid. When consumed entirely, it will grant you a single random superhuman ability in the style of Worm Webnovel. Can be purchased multiple times.

Effects: The power granted is unpredictable in both nature and strength, ranging from minor and simple to insanely potent and esoteric. However, ingestion carries severe risks, including physical mutation, mental instability, or other permanent side effects. 

Note: These changes are connected to the personal Entity Shard this vial provides for you, which is now fiat-backed. As such, mutations or side effects caused by the vial cannot be easily reversed or removed by ordinary means. You will have to work with the Shard and the connection to change power expression.

WARNING: The entire contents must be consumed to work properly! Do not take more than one vial!

You are the Innocence, a living personification of History itself. In any world you enter, you are the highest category of historical personage, elected by fate to supreme rule. Your decisions are not mere choices, but historical inevitabilities; compressed events that would have happened anyway, merely accelerated through your will. This renders you functionally infallible, as your victories are not earned through force, but because they are pre-ordained. You do not need to enforce your rule - you win because you cannot help but win. Be warned, however: false claimants and factions who oppose your ordained destiny may still arise.

Due to the nature of this state, you cannot perceive the text of this perk or consciously access its effects. It simply is. Be warned, rules of your current reality and its metaphysics can and will wrap effects of this state in various ways.

"Wield raw intellectual power. Deduce the world."

You possess a preternatural capacity for deduction and pure intellection. Piece together evidence, detect inconsistencies in statements, and impress everyone with your astonishing conclusions. Logic is the bread and butter of investigation and you have mastered it.

This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your reason. It is a calm, tireless partner in thought that causes no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your psyche is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can elevate this internal counsel to supernatural levels of insight, allowing you to unravel truths that should be impossible for human mind to discern.

"Call upon all your knowledge. Produce fascinating trivia."

Your mind is a database of facts. You innately draw upon a wealth of background knowledge on any subject - relevant to your case or utterly unrelated. The history of cigarette brands, the design of pre-Revolutionary guns, obscure cultural references, forgotten scientific trivia - all are at your fingertips when you need them most.

This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your memory and accumulated knowledge. It is a calm, tireless inner librarian that supplies fascinating information and cross-references without causing any stress or discomfort. Your potential with this aspect of your psyche is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernatural at storing, codifying, and accessing data, eventually granting you perfect recall of everything you've experienced and the ability to retrieve even the most obscure information instantly or even fill in some gaps from the data you already possess.

"Practice the art of persuasion. Enjoy rigorous intellectual discourse."

You have mastered the art of argument. Debate, nitpick, and win. Break down any argument and hear what people are truly saying beneath their words. Spot fallacies the moment they are used. Detect what was left out of a testimony, what someone is trying to divert you from, and whether a double entendre was intentional or merely an accidental lead.

This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your Rhetorical aptitude and skill. It causes no discomfort or stress, serving purely as a tool for intellectual analysis. Your potential with this aspect of your psyche is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this internal voice to dissect arguments, uncover hidden truths, and win any debate through sheer rhetorical mastery.

"Play the actor. Lie and detect lies."

The world is a stage and on it, you perform. This perk enables you to craft elaborate falsehoods, concoct wonderful stories, and adopt ingenious personas with masterful stagecraft. You become a virtuoso of fourberie and deceit. Conversely, you can see through the performances of others: if someone lies to you, you will know it immediately.

This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your Dramatic aptitude. It causes no discomfort or stress, serving purely as a tool for deception and truth-seeking. Your potential with this aspect of your psyche is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this internal voice to perform, deceive, and uncover the false performances of others.

"Understand creativity. See Art in the world."

You possess the ability to make fresh associations and delve into world-concepts: from postmodernist karperie to arabesque dideridada, from the meaning of HARDCORE to the hidden connections between seemingly unrelated ideas. More importantly, you can add your own contributions to these works, creating new art and new concepts that enrich the world around you.

This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your Conceptualization ability. It causes no discomfort or stress, serving purely as a tool for creative insight. Your potential with this aspect of your psyche is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this internal voice to perceive art everywhere and generate original concepts of profound depth and beauty.

"Reconstruct crime scenes. Make laws of physics work for the Law."

You possess the ability to create virtual reconstructions within your mind's eye. Trace a bullet's trajectory from shattered glass with mathematical precision. Count footprints at a glance and discern shoe size, design, and the height, weight, and gender of the one who wore them. You make the laws of nature serve justice.

This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your Visual Calculus skill. It causes no discomfort or stress, serving purely as a tool for spatial analysis and reconstruction. Your potential with this aspect of your psyche is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this internal voice to reconstruct events, analyze physical evidence, and make the invisible visible.

"Hold yourself together. Keep your Morale up."

You possess an unbreakable core of will. Volition enables you to resist temptation in all its forms - whether it waits in a bottle, between a pair of legs, or at the end of an iron barrel promising oblivion. It gives you the strength to continue when all else falters, bolstering your resolve and protecting your spirit from breaking.

This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your willpower and integrity. It is a calm, steady presence that encourages you to be good to others and to yourself, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your psyche is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this inner voice to maintain morale, resist corruption, and hold yourself together against any force that seeks to tear you apart.

"Hunches and gut feelings. Dreams in waking life."

You possess an unfiltered wellspring of imagination, emotion, and foreboding. Inland Empire enables you to grope your way through invisible dimensions of reality, gaining insight into that which sight cannot see. You sense what is really going on beneath the surface: the enigmatic riddles, the hidden meanings, the whispers of world-fate.

This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your intuition and dreamlike perception. It speaks in hunches, feelings, and strange certainties, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your psyche is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this inner voice to perceive the invisible, interpret the inexplicable, and navigate the dreamlike dimensions of reality.

"Understand others. Work your mirror neurons."

You possess the ability to break into the souls of others and feel what lies within. Empathy enables you to notice social cues that others miss: a hidden sadness you could coax out, a strange joy in someone who should be grieving, or a buried resentment that could one day return to harm you. You understand what people truly feel, beneath their words and masks.

This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your capacity for emotional insight. It speaks in feelings and intuitions about others, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your psyche is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this inner voice to perceive the hidden emotional truths of anyone you encounter.

"Intimidate the public. Assert yourself."

You possess an innate understanding of power dynamics. Authority enables you to assert and reassert your dominance over those around you: reading groups of thugs, knowing exactly how far you can push a perpetrator, and establishing control over any situation. You command respect, fear, or obedience as the moment demands.

This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your capacity for command and intimidation. It speaks in certainties about power, boundaries, and control, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your psyche is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this inner voice to dominate social dynamics, break resistance, and make your authority absolute.

"Connect to Station 41. Understand cop culture."

You possess the very spirit of policing - the cop-geist. Esprit de Corps enables you to understand your blue-souled sisters and brothers on a profound level, picking up subtle signals from partners and allies. More remarkably, you experience flash-sideways scenes of your comrades as they play out elsewhere (glimpses of precinct life, moments of danger, acts of solidarity) allowing you to coordinate and connect across distance.

This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your attunement to brotherhood and shared purpose. It speaks in loyalty, understanding, and flashes of distant events, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your psyche is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this inner voice to forge unbreakable bonds with allies and sense their struggles wherever they may be.

"Charm men and women. Play the puppet-master."

You possess the art of soft power. Suggestion enables you to implant ideas into the minds of others, making them believe your desires are their own. Charm citizens into liking you more. Plant doubt in gangsters until they turn on each other - many crime rings have fallen to a single well-placed whisper. When people think they want what you want, you've already won.

This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your persuasive talent. It speaks in subtlety and influence, suggesting the perfect words to plant, the right doubts to sow, causing no discomfort or stress to you. Your potential with this aspect of your psyche is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this inner voice to shape thoughts, manipulate desires, and orchestrate outcomes without ever appearing to pull the strings.

"Take the blows. Don't let the world kill you."

Your metabolism and circulatory system operate at peak capacity. Endurance enables you to survive punishment that would fell others: bullets, toxins, environmental hazards, and the general wear and tear of existence. Who cares if you can't aim a gun if you can take a few bullets? Why fear drugs that harm the body when you are a very, very healthy man?

This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your physical resilience and survival instinct. It speaks in sensations of your body's limits and capacities, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your physiology is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at pushing your body beyond its breaking point, surviving the unsurvivable, and letting the world exhaust itself trying to kill you.

"Shrug off the pain. They'll have to hurt you more."

You possess an extraordinary capacity to ignore damage - physical and mental alike. Pain Threshold enables you to negate suffering that would stop others, pushing on bloodied and crawling to the bitterest end. Broken bones, gunshot wounds, heartache, loneliness - all can be set aside. In fact, you may find yourself perversely seeking out pain, reveling in the thrill of enduring what should break you.

This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your ability to transcend suffering. It speaks in defiance and endurance, acknowledging pain without letting it stop you, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your physiology is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this inner resilience to shrug off wounds that would kill lesser beings and find strength in the very agony that would destroy others.

"Flex powerful muscles. Enjoy healthy organs."

Your body is a weapon perfectly honed. Physical Instrument encompasses not just your muscles and skeleton, but your ability to use them with devastating effectiveness. Perform push-ups, sit-ups, knockout punches, and 360-degree spin-kicks with equal ease. A one-size-fits-all solution to thriving and surviving in a physical world.

This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your body's capabilities and potential. It speaks in sensations of power, balance, and kinetic opportunity, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your physiology is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding your physical form as the perfect instrument: moving with impossible precision, striking with unimaginable force, and executing feats of athleticism that defy belief.

"Go to party planet. Love and be loved by drugs."

The animal within you - the beast longing to be unleashed to indulge and enjoy. Electrochemistry enables you to consume substances with dramatically reduced negative side effects while retaining their benefits. More than mere hedonism, it guides you through lurid matters: understanding chemical breakdowns, communicating with the intoxicated, and navigating the complex dynamics of desire and indulgence.

This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your body's appetites and chemical wisdom. It speaks in urges, tolerances, and insights into the altered states of yourself and others, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your physiology is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this inner voice to process toxins, understand chemistry on an intuitive level, and navigate the darkest corners of human indulgence with perfect clarity.

"Raise the hair on your neck. Tune in to the city."

You possess a supra-natural connection to the spirit of the place you inhabit. Shivers awakens when the temperature drops and awareness sharpens, allowing you to hear the city itself, to truly belong to the streets. Old wrongs play out before you in present time; scenes across the city unfold in your perception as they happen. Someone (something) speaks to you through the wind and the cold.

This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your attunement to the hidden life of cities and lands. It speaks in chills, whispers, and glimpses of distant moments, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your physiology is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this inner voice to perceive events across vast distances, sense the history embedded in your surroundings, and hear the secrets that only the world itself knows.

"Let the body take control. Threaten people."

Your fight-or-flight response raised to an art form. Half Light enables you to sense when situations are about to turn violent or desperate, often before any conscious sign appears. It injects palpable fear into your heart, fear that urges action before it's too late, fear that makes you frighten others in turn. This is the aggression that lets you squeeze every last drop of information from a witness, the instinct that keeps you alive when reason would freeze.

This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your primal survival instinct and aggression. It speaks in adrenaline, threat assessment, and the urge to strike first, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your physiology is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this inner voice to sense danger before it manifests, intimidate others with primal ferocity, and let your body take control when hesitation means death.

"Ready? Aim and fire."

Your connection between hand and eye is extraordinary. Hand/Eye Coordination governs every interaction with objects in flight: catching coins tossed by mob bosses, throwing with precision, and above all, shooting straight. You understand firearms intimately: the precise make and model of any pistol at a glance, its quirks and capabilities, and exactly how to use it. Want to identify a weapon? This skill has you covered. Want to shoot someone with it? Ditto.

This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your physical precision and firearm intuition. It speaks in trajectories, targeting data, and the perfect moment to release, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your physiology is heightened beyond human limits. Over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this inner voice to achieve impossible accuracy, master any projectile weapon, and catch or throw with preternatural precision.

"See, hear and smell everything. Let no detail go unnoticed."

Your senses operate at full capacity, open to the world in ways others cannot match. Perception enables you to notice what everyone else misses: the wad of bills hidden in a sugar bowl, the odor of a perpetrator beneath floorboards, the nervous gulp of a suspect claiming innocence. Every detail, every clue, every lie revealed through sight, sound, and smell.

This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your heightened awareness and sensory intuition. It speaks in observations, anomalies, and the things that don't quite fit, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your physiology and psychology is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this inner voice to perceive the imperceptible, detect the hidden, and let no detail (however small) escape your notice.

"The quickest to react. An untouchable man."

Your body and mind move with preternatural agility and instinct. Reaction Speed enables you to dodge physical threats (punches, knives, bullets) with fluid grace. But it also sharpens your mental reflexes: you're never lost for words, never lacking a witty comeback, always streetwise in conversation. Your mental alacrity lets you connect little details on the fly, working in perfect tandem with your intellect to synthesize information in the heat of the moment.

This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your physical and mental quickness. It speaks in split-second decisions, instinctive dodges, and the perfect retort arriving exactly when needed, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your physiology and psychology is heightened beyond human limits. Over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this inner voice to react to the impossible, evade certain death, and react to things before they actually happen.

"Sneak under their noses. Stun with immense panache."

You move through the world with style, grace, and undeniable cool. Savoir Faire enables you to slip past unnoticed in Samaran boxing style, tumble out the back with unexpected acrobatics, and lift evidence from perpetrators without their knowledge. Your footsteps fall silent when needed, your body grooves to any good beat, and your athletic flair impresses all who witness it. You are simply disco - a cooler cop, a smoother operator, a presence that cannot be ignored or caught.

This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your style, stealth, and panache. It speaks in rhythm, opportunity, and the perfect moment to move, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your physiology and psychology is heightened beyond human limits. Over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this inner voice to achieve impossible stealth, execute breathtaking acrobatics, and stun the world with your immense, undeniable flair.

"Master machines. Pick locks and pockets."

You possess an intuitive connection to the mechanical world. Interfacing enables you to understand, use, and improve machines of all kinds: repairing motor carriages, analyzing how a suspect used a pen, rewiring electrical circuits, and coaxing functionality from broken devices. Beyond pure mechanics, this skill extends to delicate manual theft: lifting keys from a keyring without notice, picking locks with practiced ease, and liberating objects from pockets. Machines are tools, and you are their master.

This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your mechanical intuition and manual dexterity. It speaks in diagrams, friction points, and the whisper of tumblers falling into place, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your physiology and psychology is heightened beyond human limits. Over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this inner voice to interface with any technology, repair the irreparable, and liberate anything that can be lifted or unlocked.

"Straighten your back. Keep your poker face."

You are a fortress of emotional control. Composure enables you to maintain an unshakeable front, hiding your true feelings from the world while reading the cracks in everyone else's facade. You sense when others are about to break, when their body language betrays their words, when their composure is merely performance. And you do it all while looking good: no slouching, no tells, just perfect poise that makes any outfit work.

This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your emotional control and social perception. It speaks in posture corrections, micro-expression analysis, and reminders to maintain your cool, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your physiology and psychology is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this inner voice to become utterly unreadable, perceive the hidden emotions of others with perfect clarity, and maintain flawless composure in any situation.

column4: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind
column5:
You possess the technological knowledge of the world after the Seven Days of Fire. Your knowledge is practical and rooted in remnant-based engineering - making do with what remains while reaching toward what was lost. This covers two distinct fields:

>Mechanical: You can build machines from exotic and simple materials alike, including aircraft technology ranging from Eftal's flying ships to Dorok's hovering wooden constructs, with foundational knowledge that points toward true spacecraft.

>Biotechnology: You understand cloning, the creation of consuming molds, biological enhancements for survivability and lifespan, and even the transfer of minds between bodies.

Choose a skill or trait. You gain superhuman talent within that domain, allowing you to progress and improve at speeds and in ways impossible for ordinary people. You gain a large chest filled with Adra: an organic, crystalline material that acts as a conduit for souls. Easy to carve yet profoundly potent, adra can store and transport souls, bind them to constructs, and serve as the foundation for advanced animancy. The Engwithans used it for everything from architecture to weapons to soul-manipulation on a vast scale.

Your chest contains adra in various configurations: raw veins, cut gems, processed ingots, and even samples infused with luminous properties. You may withhold its appearance until a suitable time and place.

You gain extensive theoretical knowledge of animancy - the field of study that uses machines to examine and manipulate soul energy. You understand how souls function, how they can be stored, transferred, and bound to constructs, and the mechanical principles required to build the necessary technology. Your practical skills are beginner-level, requiring further development to match true masters, but your theoretical foundation is rock-solid and broad. This knowledge allows you to work with soul essence, create soul-powered constructs, and potentially disrupt or preserve the cycle of life and death - a sensitive art that many regard as necromancy.

You are a student of academic magic, wielding power through intense study, mental discipline, and specially enchanted grimoires. Your grimoire acts as a magical capacitor, absorbing ambient soul energy and releasing it through spell pages to alter reality. Your possible repertoire includes spells that conjure flame, lightning, and acid; warp time; harden flesh to stone; counter hostile magic; and summon nightmares from thin air.

You begin as a novice wizard, knowing a handful of basic spells and knowing how to make a modest starter grimoire. Further study, research, and adventuring will expand your repertoire, allowing you to add new spells to your collection or even develop original ones. You may acquire additional grimoires to access different spell selections, though wielding an archmage's tome requires experience to manage its power safely.

You possess the rare mental ability to directly contact and manipulate another person's soul and psyche. Unlike wizards who channel magic through grimoires, you operate directly through the power of your mind, using the essence of allies or enemies as the focus for your abilities. You begin as a novice cipher, your abilities raw but potent. Further practice and exposure to other souls will expand your repertoire. 

Your talents potentially allow you to peer through spiritual energy, read surface thoughts, extract memories, inflict psychic wounds, and even seize control of others' actions. In combat, you build focus by striking foes or drawing on allies, then expend that focus to unleash devastating mental powers: from phantom pains and soul shredding to domination and psychic volleys.

You are a storyteller who wields magic by reciting ancient tales and hallowed legends. Your chants stir the collective memory of wayward souls around you, compelling them to generate magical effects in a kind of spectral reenactment.

By weaving iconic phrases into sustained chants, you grant allies a stack of minor bonuses over a wide area - all while remaining free to fight or move. Your invocations are more powerful spells, unleashed once you've built enough phrases, and you possess the greatest number of summoning abilities among all classes, calling forth spectral allies to fight at your side.

You begin with a repertoire of known phrases and invocations, rooted in folk traditions and oral histories of your current location and homeland. Further adventuring and exposure to new legends will expand your collection.

You are an animist who draws power from the spiritual essence flowing through all living things. Your magic manifests as natural phenomena (storms, coiling plants, rapid decay) reflecting your primal connection to the world. You also possess the ability to spiritshift, temporarily taking on the aspect of a powerful beast.

You begin with a single spiritshift form (choose from categories like cat, bear, wolf, or stag) and a modest repertoire of nature-themed spells. Further experience allows you to learn additional forms and spells, though each new form requires balancing its essence within yourself. Unlike priests, you do not serve a deity - you revere the web of life itself.

You are a devotee of a specific deity, drawing power from the strength of your personal faith rather than direct divine intervention. Your abilities stem from your soul's connection to your god's dominion, manifesting as prayers - miracles that aid allies and punish enemies. You begin as an adventuring priest, your faith strong but your experience limited. Further deeds and devotion will expand your prayers and deepen your connection to your deity.

Your repertoire potentially includes healing magic, protective barriers, weapon enchantments, blessings, curses, and divine summons. Your spells are aligned with your chosen god's nature; a priest of Eothas wields light and life, while a priest of Berath commands decay and passage. You are competent in combat, trained in the weapons and armor favored by your church.

When you defeat an opponent that qualifies as a "boss" or "mini-boss" tier threat or obstacles in the context of the conflict/challenge, they erupt in a spectacular fountain of thematic loot. Weapons, armor, gold, and curiosities shower from their fallen form, each piece enchanted in the style of Diablo games: bearing magical properties, set bonuses, and rarities ranging from magic to legendary. The loot is always thematically appropriate to the defeated foe and the environment, it also usually somewhat useful for you. 

For Additional 200 CP: This perk now can be toggled on or off at will, allowing you to control when you want the fireworks, or when you prefer a clean, discreet victory.

Rarely and randomly, a Treasure Goblin spawns somewhere nearby. These devious little creatures exist solely to hoard wealth, and all who perceive them instinctively understand the deal: kill the goblin, take its loot. Goblins do not fight: they flee, dropping a trail of valuables as they run, attempting to reach safety and conjure an escape portal. Attacking them disrupts the portal, but you must be quick; if they escape or are left alone too long, they vanish entirely.

Of course, these goblins have a cruel sense of humor. They always appear in situations where pursuit is difficult, annoying, or genuinely risky: during combat, in hostile territory, or when you're otherwise occupied. But the reward is always worth the trouble: a shower of valuables and enchanted items, Diablo-style, scaled to be useful to whoever claims it.

+200 CP (Treasure Realm): On rare occasions, killing a Treasure Goblin opens a shimmering portal to the Vault - Greed's personal domain, where all stolen riches are hoarded. Within lies a short, treasure-filled level culminating in an encounter with Greed itself. Upon its defeat, Greed's Strongbox crashes down, bursting with legendary loot. A 60-second timer then begins; loot quickly and escape before the realm collapses. Portals are blocked until the chest is opened.

Possessing Wild Magic makes you immune to the effects of World Items but World Item holders also become immune to your Wild Magic.

You can stack multiple metamagic effects on a single spell and store metamagic in scrolls, potions, or wands. You can even employ rare techniques like Over Magic, temporarily allowing you to cast spells above your normal tier.

Super-Tier Magic transcends the boundaries of ordinary magic casting, world-shaking invocations that behave more like divine abilities than true spells. You can access these powers and wield them with far greater efficiency than normal casters.

You may learn numerous Super-Tier spells, cast them more often, and benefit from shorter cooldowns. Their casting time shortens, their power amplifies, and their cost becomes negligible compared to traditional limits.

With enough mastery, you become a force capable of rewriting landscapes, annihilating armies, or invoking calamities comparable to the World Items.

Arcane magic is the art of structured spellcraft, power gained through formulas, symbols, theory, and intellect. You are exceptionally efficient at constructing, controlling, and unleashing spells. Your mana stretches further, your control is cleaner, and your magical output surpasses that of most professional mages.

As your mastery rises, your spells can devastate armies, manipulate weather, reshape terrain, or temporarily rewrite the rules of nature. Teleportation, illusions, barriers, enchantments, elemental destruction, and complex ritual magic all fall under your command.

Divine magic channels the authority of gods, spirits, and natural law into miracles that heal, protect, or judge. Your connection to the sacred is exceptionally strong, allowing your prayers and invocations to manifest with unusual strength and purity.

You can restore allies from injuries, diseases, curses, or poison with effortless efficiency. Blessings you bestow enhance strength, endurance, and mental clarity; summoned beasts, spirits, or celestial guardians fight with heightened purpose beside you. Divine wrath flows through you as well capable of purging undead, demons, and corrupted beings with overwhelming force.

As your mastery deepens, your miracles broaden in scale: reshaping land, commanding weather, empowering entire groups, or transforming your body into a holy or primal form.

Spiritual Magic is an esoteric art rooted in talismans, seals, ancestral spirits, and subtle psychic force. Where other disciplines rely on raw power, you command precision and preparation instead.

You can craft talismans that carry curses, illusions, paralysis, sealing techniques, elemental blasts, and morale-shattering hexes. You may throw them like weapons, attach them to surfaces, or place them on allies to trigger protective effects. Their activation requires no mana and no casting time, allowing you to dictate the pace of any battle.

You can commune with spirits who offer elemental control, clairvoyance, exorcism, soul-perception, and fate-reading. Stronger spirits can be summoned as allies or merged temporarily with your essence, amplifying your body and magic.

You specialize in empowering yourself and others with potent, long-lasting enhancements. Your buffs take hold faster, last longer, and stack more efficiently. Strength, speed, reflexes, durability, focus, magical output and various other buffs are all elevated beyond natural limits.

At higher mastery, your enhancements can become battlefield-wide blessings, transforming entire groups into forces capable of overturning armies.

Your magic specializes in dominating the battlefield itself, controlling positioning, movement, morale, and coordination. You excel at area spells that bind, stun, freeze, silence, confuse, terrify, charm, or paralyze.

Your effects persist longer, resist dispelling, and strike harder than other casters’, granting you overwhelming tactical superiority. Armies crumble not because you kill them, but because they cannot act. Even high-level enemies find it difficult to maintain composure or resist your influence.

Ki is the inner life-force of living beings, raw vitality refined into strength. You have the potential of a martial prodigy, able to sense life energy, reinforce your body, empower your attacks, sharpen your senses, and push past human limits effortlessly.

With training you may master abilities such as rapid healing, body-hardening, shockwave punches, hyper-awareness, and even projectiles of condensed Ki. Your stamina regeneration and physical durability vastly exceed baseline humans.

Your body rejects the concept of fatal precision. Weak-point strikes, vital blows, and critical hits lose their lethality, reduced to ordinary damage. No amount of skill or accuracy allows enemies to exploit anatomical vulnerabilities.

This method is very stable and popular. It allows for precise control over growth conditions. Because of its predictability and reproducibility, large and complex recipes can be created with great results. However, manipulation is difficult due to the enclosed nature of the jar and adjustments must be done with extreme care to avoid ruining the experiment.

Homunculi grown using the Seed Method develop like plants. They may be the plant itself or grow as a fruit on one. They require careful nurturing. Sunlight must be sufficient, and they must be watered regularly. The soil must be of good quality. Magical fertilizer may also be necessary. Once the initial setup is complete, they only need routine care.

Due to its flexible nature, it is also the most forgiving of errors, as long as you are willing to put in the work.

Both for your own sake or the sake of others whom you’ve taken on their grudge. You also attract those who want revenge or require justice and don’t have a better way of achieving it.

Your body heals itself of fatigue and wounds. The closer you get to death, the more grayscale your vision will become. Not getting hit for a second or two will cause you to regenerate until you’re healed.

You’ve learned the secrets of bullet hell, or Danmaku for short. This enables you to create a variety of color coded bullets. Which have an effect you define, in patterns you can pre-program. For starters, you can fire a white bullet that moves very fast but has no other special effects. A yellow bullet that splits into other colored bullets when it impacts something. A purple bullet that homes in on your targets. And a green bullet that heals those it impacts. You can teach yourself more bullet types and patterns with time and practice.

You’re an efficient and deadly close range combat expert. More than skill, it’s the instincts and the certainty of your movements that makes you so dangerous. You can often drop lesser foes in a single strike. Few could call you their equal in melee.

You’ll notice moments of opportunity in life. These allow you to pull off gambles and respond to events in ways that favor you. Land a shot that takes out a helicopter, jump your car off a ramp to get over a broken bridge. Even struggle your way out of the death grip of a monster that grabbed you! You can apply this to pretty much anything, if you can get the timing right.

You can jinx others and cause them to fail at crucial moments. Especially when they attempt risky gambles might pay off. A tricky dog fighting technique could cause them to crash their plane. An attempt to jump their car off a building would have them flip and fall to their death. Your bad luck effect always works to a degree. It’s even more potent when someone does anything risky or dangerous.

You spawn power ups in the environment where you’re fighting. They’ll also be dropped by defeated enemies. These include speed boosts, health regeneration, ammo pickups, and others. You can also enforce a logic that causes many items that wouldn’t explode to explode. So shooting at a barrel could cause it to blow up, and cars that you shoot in the gas tank will explode.

You can perform a short range teleport when near something that acts as cover. Anything you can hide behind or stick your body to is a valid target. Cover is stronger when it’s you hiding behind it. A wooden table could withstand an entire magazine of rounds before failing.

Everybody has a stash in the Zone. What, you think they have banks out here? It’s all a barter system and more often than not you won’t be able to carry all of your valuables with you. When that happens, you make a stash. With this perk, any stash you make is nigh undetectable by others. Note that stashes are typically small, out of the way containers or crannies. Make your stash too big and this protection fails.

Through training, trial and error or a stolen manual, you've managed to learn the secrets to exoskeletons and powered armor. Not only can you build and maintain them, should you have the materials, you've figured out how to make them run at speed. Applying this insight to other sets of powered armor, you can increase their movement speed and flexibility by leaps and bounds

While you aren’t immune to radiation, this perk allows you to ignore up to a moderate case of radiation poisoning and will filter any remaining isotopes out of your system over time. Also works with worn/held items, effectively allowing you to (over time) sanitize irradiated items with a touch.

You're not sure what everyone's freaking out over, anomaly fields aren't that bad once you know their tricks. You're able to navigate hazardous terrain and anomalies with little hassle though careless movement can get even the best killed. In addition, there's a noticeable improvement in the quality of the loot you find. Just don't let the bandits find out, yeah?

An infinite pouch of bolts of varying size. Conductive and non-irradiated, they're a great multipurpose tool for any stalker worth their salt. Use it to test anomalies, distract enemies or just throw them at people who annoy you.

You have harnessed the innate mystical energy of magic to breathe life into your flames. Your sorcery brings light and fire into existence, scorching all who dare approach. Cast your spells of the sun, grasp at the great holy light above and bring down fiery wrath on your foes.

Fire is a part of you. Flames lick your very thoughts, and you’ve learned to manifest the flames in your dreams and interweave them onto the material plane. Your psychic powers draw upon your infinite rage, your wrath, your hatred, and your passion to ignite the air around you. Can you steady your very essence and grasp the power which is being offered to you?
You have vast understanding of fire and thermodynamics, and your power of fire comes from your knowledge and technology.

You are a beast, a creature formed from the ashes left behind. You are what’s left once the flames are gone, once they’ve cooled. Yet, your rage never cooled, your will never froze, and so you stood from those ashes and became an ashen beast.

The fires of passion, honed to a deadly point. You have spent your life sharpening your passion into a weapon, a force of ruin to make those you grasp at dance to your whims. You have the natural ability to play the strings of passion in others, twisting the fire within them around your finger and holding them captive at the sight of you. Twist their emotions, control their bodies, and remake their minds through your perfect understanding of psychology until you tire of them and stab them through the back.

The breath of life, the fires of existence, the burning within from which true understanding dawns. Your flames are the flames of creation, molding and changing life itself. Your fires do not harm, they do not heal, they advance. You hold holy flame at the tips of your fingers, flame which can be molded into various metals and materials and more importantly, flame which grants a soul to anything which is created. Hand the future to your children, and they will give you the world.
Your power over fire is eldritch in nature. It is no longer so much fire, as it’s reality warping with a fire aesthetic.

You can control flames at a basic level. Your power and control grows without bounds, based only on what’s required to fuel it and the training and knowledge you have on the subject. If you’re a pyromancer, this grants a small mana pool and knowledge of basic fire spells. If you’re a Pyrokinetic, this grants you increased willpower and mental endurance and basic psychic fire abilities. If you’re a Pyrotechnitian, this grants you a basic understanding of chemistry, physics, and thermodynamics in addition to some technology related to them. The Ashen Beast can manipulate ash around them to a small extent to add natural weapons to themselves, while a Dancer gains an extensive education in psychology and the Promethean can create basic items from the Fires of Creation. The Pyre gains small-scale, localized reality warping which can be trained up and knowledge on fire-related reality-editing abilities.

>Requires one or more Origins from Generic Fire Manipulation

You have the equivalent of 10 years of experience in fire manipulation. You have a repertoire of spells, abilities, and technologies which can perform simple to moderately complex operations related to fire. You can light a building on fire, incinerate bones, cause spontaneous combustion, shape fire into various shapes, and understand various principles regarding the physical world in order to build technology and bombs. Lots of bombs. A Dancer gains nearly supernatural capabilities in manipulating others and assassination techniques, and a Promethean can create nearly anything with their flames that they can see.

>Requires one or more Origins from Generic Fire Manipulation
>Requires Basic Flame Manipulation

You have a solid 30 years of experience now. You can probably light up a city block and have the mana reserves, willpower, and mental endurance to maintain that for a while. You can create powerful weapons, items and technology which utilize fire in order to accomplish your goals, from building complex factories to machinery and equipment which runs entirely off of fire instead of electricity. Your psychology would be beyond supernatural now, able to force others to dance to your strings, and your Flames of Creation would be capable of creating magical items. An Ashen Beast can fully reform their body into various shapes and heal from damage. Your reality warping allows you to impose your view of reality, particularly that of a burning and scorched reality, on the world around you in a city block’s area.

>Requires one or more Origins from Generic Fire Manipulation
>Requires Beginner Flame Manipulation

you have 100 years of experience in fire manipulation. Your flames can Engulf a city, probably even more if you push yourself. Your control is improved, you have significantly increased mana reserves and willpower, and dozens of not hundreds of spells and abilities under your belt. Your reality warping is such that you can affect massive swathes of land, edit reality to add in fire ex-nihilo, scorch the earth with a thought, and reduce villages to ash and bones without even requiring fire. A Dancer can talk nearly anyone into nearly anything, even able to talk non-sapient beings into doing their bidding while a Promethean can create life itself and imbue it with a soul. An Ashen Beast can modify their physiology fully into any form and both control and feel through their ash at a magnificent distance.

>Requires one or more Origins from Generic Fire Manipulation
>Requires Intermediate Flame Manipulation

You have 500 years of experience in fire manipulation. Your skills and abilities have expanded to be able to ignite anything short of a planet, scorching continents. Your technology can bend the laws of physics and perform feats which would leave scientists dumbfounded. Build bombs which ignite matter itself, creating a self-sustaining explosion. Build a perpetual motion machine. A Dancer can talk the world into changing how they want it to, and an Ashen Beast can grant themselves powers through the forms they take. A Promethean can create incredible constructs that border on divinity. Your reality warping is also now advanced enough to breathe actual life into constructs by manipulating and generating the flames of life.

>Requires one or more Origins from Generic Fire Manipulation
>Requires Advanced Flame Manipulation

You use magic to imbue philosophy with power and enact that philosophy on the world around you. You wield mystic energy to shape the flow of water and thought, summoning forth water to control the battlefield and understand the very concept of your foes.

Your mind has evolved to use psychic energy to manipulate the forces of water. You move liquids through sheer force of will, shaping it to your whims. Some say that psychics who control water are mad witches who curse travelers with eternal bad luck, but that’s just superstition… right?

You are a master of illusions and light. You understand instinctively how light refracts against surfaces such as water or mirrors, able to shape that light into powerful illusions that control not only sight, but any of the senses and even insidiously infect the mind.
You’re a scientist, one who plays with the body and blood. Your power comes from personal augmentations, knowledge, and mad science. Can you contain yourself?

column2: Origin: Cultist of the Deep Ones
column5: You’re one who worships the beings who exist outside of our reality. You hold no power of your own, but yet you have the power that the elder gods of the infinite ocean allow you to have as their host.

You are a sage, one who uses plants and imbues them with chi in order to draw out their supernatural elements. By using a combination of your water chi and various plants, you can create healing salves, poisons, drugs, and various other effects.

Perhaps you’re not a primordial yet, but you have a natural connection to water such that others may think you are one. You are one with the water around you, able to move it freely through will alone, as you are the water and the water is you.

You can control water at a basic level. Whether through magic, psychic energy, chi, or another method, you’re able to move the waves to your whim. You have a small reserve of energy to perform these actions with, whether mana for a Mysticist, chi for an Herbalist, or something stranger. 

A Mysticist has learned the basics of infusing water with mana to manipulate it, casting basic spells and learning minor thaumaturgy. A hydrokinetic understands the basics of using psychic energy to perform similar feats. A mirror demon knows how to create simple illusions which fool the eyes of others. A biologist has knowledge of medicine and genetics. A cultist has the fortitude to contract with lesser horrors and allow them into their body for a presence in the world. An herbalist understands basic chi manipulation to grow plants and herbs and how to make simple healing concoctions and poisons. A primordial has a weak connection to the natural world and can will water into existence.

>Requires one or more Origins from Generic Water Manipulation

You’ve been around for 10 years. You have a repertoire of spells, skills, abilities, and technologies that you can use, from simple to moderately complex. Thrash and churn the seas and summon the water out of the atmosphere, crush concrete and break bones. 

A Mysticist finds their meditation allows them to infuse their magic into metaphor, drawing on the power of philosophy and adding this to their water magic. Hydrokinetics have greater force and power, and a mirror demon can create more complex illusions. Biologists understand genetics and biology to the point of being able to perform surgery with suboptimal tools and modify others into monstrosities, while cultists have enough insanity and constitution to allow powerful monsters into their souls and channel those powers. Primordials have expanded capabilities and can control their created water as an extension of themselves, crushing and pulverizing concrete, houses, and people

>Requires one or more Origins from Generic Water Manipulation
>Requires Basic Water Manipulation

You have 30 years of practice has culminated in this. Your power expands beyond their normal bounds, allowing you to flood a city block and crush people into paste. Control the water pressure, put tens of thousands of gallons of water into a small ball, and shred steel and stone with your churning waves. Your energy reserves have increased to handle this power, as well. 

Mysticists have much more control over the conceptual aspects of water, infusing human thought and the collective unconscious into their magic. Hydrokinetics boast massive power and pure brute force. A mirror demon learns to control more senses than sight, though with less finesse, and some control over light and its refraction on mirror surfaces. A biologist begins their descent into madness and mad science, able to manipulate genetics and fuse species together, even creating new creatures altogether. Learning the language of the gods becomes easier for cultists, allowing them to speak their frenzied thoughts into existence, and herbalists can develop potent poisons and concoctions and learn to manipulate plant life with their chi. Even a primordial begins to extend its connection with the waters across the world, expanding themselves and extending into new places, creating constructs out of water to expand their influence.

>Requires one or more Origins from Generic Water Manipulation
>Requires Beginner Water Manipulation

You have 100 years of experience in water manipulation. Your capabilities begin reaching the levels of phenomenal power, able to eradicate a city through sheer force and overwhelming strength. Your water and abilities tear apart the very molecules holding matter together. 

Philosophy practically radiates out of your power as a Mysticist, wrapping all of your magic in the power and versatility of metaphor. A hydrokinetic can tear apart entire cities and countries through the water vapor sitting in every structure. A mirror demon creates illusions which encompass all senses, able to even inflict pain and pleasure at will and control light as if it were a physical thing. Biologists create terrors, modify bodies, and are masters of surgery and bodily modification, able to strengthen and alter bodies to add animal characteristics, minor powers, and even dip into modifying the metaphysical properties of living things. Herbalists can create poisons so potent that the very sight of them infects someone, and use their chi to rapidly grow and add new properties to plants, even making plants sapient. A cultist learns to summon the horror they worship, more easily create contracts, and can channel the power of horrors without inviting them into their soul. A primordial learns to create local laws of the universe which affect small areas, up to the size of a town, and modify the laws that reality abides by.

>Requires one or more Origins from Generic Water Manipulation
>Requires Intermediate Water Manipulation

You have 500 years have passed, and your capabilities have grown in turn. You can flood planets, use water to strip the very earth of all resources, drown the mantle, and erase all evidence of life having ever lived. 

A mysticist finds their philosophy influencing the world around them, through meditation and magic, changing nature to better suit them and their flowing ideals. Hydrokinetics learn both fine control on the level of molecular finesse while holding the sheer strength to punch holes through nearly anything not completely indestructible. Mirror demons can use reflections to completely dominate the mind of those caught in their illusions, controlling all senses perfectly and modifying all stimuli. Biologists can build creatures and manipulate genetics on a massive level, even manipulating their own genes to grant themselves powers capable of tearing apart continents or affecting planets wholesale, while an herbalist can grow herbs able to bring entire countries back to life or granting the powers a biologist may tinker, and even manipulate plantlife on a massive scale. A primordial has attuned with the nature of the entire planet and beyond, gaining great influence in the way nature exists and how the natural laws of the world function.

>Requires one or more Origins from Generic Water Manipulation
>Requires Advanced Water Manipulation

You’re educated in the field of linguistics, with the equivalent of a philosophical doctorate in a subject at least somewhat related to linguistics or languages. You know all about sentence structure, participles, phonemes, and other sentence stuff. This includes the holy grail of hidden knowledge: You know when it is appropriate to use a semicolon.

In this world language can have literal, magical power. You know incantations for some basic cantrips, and you’re able to discover other magic incantations by studying and experimenting with the spells you have.

You’re fluent in a form of sign language, and are able to use signing in place of speech for the purposes of spells, powers, and perks. When you encounter others who sign, they’re guaranteed to know this form of sign language.

What are you supposed to do when the alien species you’ve encountered communicates exclusively through a pheromone-based language? Here’s your solution. When you lack the physical ability to express yourself in a language, you’re able to train your body to make up the difference, somehow.  

Learn to control your pheromone production just well enough to be a skilled communicator in insect-speak, or learn to emit telepathic signals just well enough to communicate with members of a psychic society. You can only train qualities with this perk if it's necessary to communicate in a language you’ve encountered - if you haven’t encountered any psychics, you aren’t able to pick up telepathyspeak.

You’re exceptionally talented at playing and designing word games. You know all sorts of obscure words, and find it easy to pick up on hidden meanings and codes. As a side-effect, you’re also a little bit funnier. You’d make a great editor for the crossword.

column2: Why waste time say lot word…
column5: …When few word do trick? By omitting some non-essential words from your speech, you’re able to communicate ideas significantly faster, without detracting from your listener’s ability to understand you. You know exactly which words you need to retain in order to be understood. This also makes you an expert at making understandable text-abbreviations.

Whether innuendo or euphemism, you’re a master of implying things without actually stating them outright. Useful for speaking of secrets in open spaces, engaging in doublespeak, dancing around censorship, and sneaking “dirty jokes” into kids’ shows that only older viewers will understand. When you’re about to imply something in this manner, you always know who amongst your intended audience will receive the implication.

When studying a new language, you rapidly gain proficiency in all language skills (listening comprehension, vocabulary, grammar, reading, speaking, and writing). Furthermore, your skills in every language you know are linked, allowing you to increase your speaking proficiency by studying grammar, increase your reading proficiency by practicing conversation, etc. This ability also applies to variant local dialects.

You’re educated in the field of memetics, able to predict how certain ideas will evolve when exposed to the public. You can easily guess the end-result of a game of “telephone” with a high degree of accuracy, predict whether that fashion trend will catch on, and you can tell when the kid who saw you flying above the city streets is going to start a new religion based on you.

You can choose to manifest illusory text of the words spoken by other people in your vision, presented in whatever formatting you want - speech bubbles next to their heads, subtitles in front of them, etc. If you have the ability to read thoughts, you can manifest illusory thought bubbles as well. You can also visualize your words as speech bubbles or subtitles for other people.

You have very steady hands, and can easily replicate any style of handwriting you’ve seen. Useful for forging signatures. It doesn’t take you any effort to write quickly while keeping your handwriting legible.

You are really good at convincing people to believe things that aren’t true. Even if your target thought you were a lying liar who lies, you could present the honest truth in a way that they’d dismiss out of hand

Words can hurt. You exemplify this phrase, since you’re able to deal physical damage to others by insulting them. The more hurt the enemy feels from your insults, the more damage they take. If it was humiliating enough, you could kill someone with words alone.

You can speak with any pitch, resonance, and tone you desire. You can mimic any voice or sound you’ve heard before, and you can “throw” your voice like a ventriloquist to anywhere within your line of sight.

If you have a secret you’d like to keep, you can apply a curse to that secret, making anyone who learns of it against your will suffer from the curse’s effect. This starts out as a curse of silence, preventing the afflicted from sharing your secret (or anything), but with experimentation you can learn to put all sorts of curses on information. If you wanted, you could also use this to place blessings on information instead.

You know Esperanto, Klingon, Elvish, and every other conlang out there. You have the knowledge to create your own conlangs, and with some effort you can create languages that are tailor-made for any purpose: communicating ideas quickly, being easy to learn, sounding pretty, or any other purpose you can think of. With enough practice, you could learn to create magical languages, and optimize their magical effects in the same way.

An offensive technique used by linguists, you’re able to infuse your attacks with a quality that temporarily makes your foes spout gibberish instead of comprehensible speech. Advanced users are able to control the sounds made by targets, allowing them to mislead enemies with false orders out of the mouths of their comrades.

When you focus your attention on another person, you start getting ideas of what kinds of things would piss them off. If you wanted to, after a few minutes of observation, you could craft a sentence that would make a relatively stable person fly off the handle. You’re also proficient in making more general ‘ragebait’ designed to garner a reaction from as many people as possible.

You know the basics of a magical script that can be inscribed on objects to enchant them. At a basic level, this script can be used to reinforce objects, making them a bit tougher, and a bit lighter or heavier. With practice and experimentation, you can learn to enchant flaming swords, self-repairing clothes, nearly indestructible armor, bags of holding, runic gates to other places, and other such high-tier adventuring equipment. You learn magical scripts at double the rate.

You’re able to form physical barriers out of languages that you speak. These barriers will act as impassable walls for anyone who doesn’t speak that language, while allowing anyone who does speak that language to pass. These barriers can still be broken with effort, their durability scaling with your overall level of fluency in that language.

Do not kill, do not steal, do not lie. You can burn rules like these into the mind of anything capable of interpreting language, forcing them to comply or experience some sort of heavy consequences. The rule can be whatever you like, as long as it comes in the form of an imperative statement, and the consequences can be anything that you’re personally capable of inflicting upon that person or thing. You can only do one rule per person, at least to start.

Some ideas take on a life of their own once put out into the world. You know how to craft ideas that spread like viruses, infecting the minds and bodies of those who encounter them and forcing them to spread them to others. You could make a post online that forces readers to share it, or give a speech that turns people into zombies that happen to repeat it to everyone they encounter. 

The greater the effect one of these memetic viruses has on the minds and bodies of the afflicted, the more time and resources it takes to create. Achieve world peace, make society get obsessed with phone chargers, or make a podcast that literally bores the listeners to death. The world is your petri dish.

You’re an expert programmer with a specialization in machine-learning algorithms and large language models. You can do more than make machines that pass the turing test, though. You know how to make programs that can learn to parse semantics, granting them the ability to truly comprehend language. You’re able to design programs capable of utilizing any kind of language-based techniques you’re able to teach, as long as they have access to an output device capable of expressing that language i.e. a monitor or speaker.

t’s a commonly held opinion by warrior-types that combat is a form of conversation, and you’re inclined to agree. You’re able to use your argumentative and persuasive skills in battle to great effect; the fact that you’re currently trying to take someone’s life won’t stop them from honestly considering your request that they lower their guard, or come out from their hiding place and face you with courage. 

If that’s not enough, you can also treat conversation as a form of combat: Slice through your interlocutor’s counter-arguments with your broadsword, and everyone will agree that your argument is unbeatable. You can find all sorts of ways to utilize your combat abilities in conversation and vice-versa if you put your mind to it, and all of those pesky social conventions that would normally get in your way just.. Don’t.

The longer you meditate on a particular phrase, idiom, or expression, the more insight you gain into the power behind it, until these insights eventually crystalize into a new linguistic technique. Meditating on the concept of “letting the cat out of the bag” might eventually give you a technique to divine people’s secrets by talking to cats, meditating on the concept of “burned bridges” as a metaphor for cutting contact might give you a technique to silence people with fire, etc.
